items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday coding and agentic workflows
facts: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
Hydrogen surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high thinking level (51 vs. 50, and reaching 54 at its highest xhigh thinking setting).

Orchestrator in Google Antigravity dynamically switches between models like Carbon and Hydrogen, reaching near-Carbon task success rates on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster on average.

items.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Meetings beta for team video calls
facts: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant, follow the conversation and start on work during the meeting.
Claude Meetings is starting to roll out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans.
Support is currently available for Google Meet, with other platforms coming soon.

items.title: Inkling 2 Small multimodal MoE model now live on Together AI
facts: Inkling 2 Small has 594B parameters, 17B active parameters and a 1M-token context window.
On Together AI it costs $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $1.00 per 1M output tokens.
The multimodal MoE is built for coding, long-horizon agentic work and vision.

items.title: Google rolls out Orchestrator in Antigravity pairing Carbon and Hydrogen
facts: Orchestrator is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers, letting you run multiple models in a single session.
Orchestrator pairs a frontier model with a fast execution model: Carbon sets the plan, hands off code edits and testing to Hydrogen.
It reached near-Carbon task success rates on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while consuming 24% less quota and completing 19% faster on average.

items.title: Developers share multi-model Claude Code team setups for agents
facts: A shared prompt configures Claude Code as a 4-model team: Sonnet 5.5 runs the session, Fable 5.2 as advisor, Opus 5.5 as checker, Haiku 5.5 as scout.
The setup uses settings.json for model and advisorModel, plus agent files for checker and scout that never edit files.

items.title: Hot discussion on diversifying AI agent platforms to avoid single points of failure
facts: Advice shared to map agent jobs, sort locked vs off-board, and move jobs while nothing is broken to diversify platforms.
Use of group chats with agents like GrokBot, Muse, and others, plus shared vaults for project context.

items.title: Community tips for making Claude Fable 5.2 treat codebase as its own
facts: A single sentence in the project's CLAUDE.md file is reported to improve Fable 5.2's cleanup of repeated code from under 1 in 10 tries to about half.
The sentence is: this codebase is yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll keep building on it.

items.title: Claude Code changelog bot notes upcoming 2.1.323 release
facts: Unofficial Claude Code Changelog account posted that Claude Code 2.1.323 is about to be released.
